title: Photodynamic therapy for the skin
what: A special cream is applied to your skin that makes the changed cells sensitive to light. Then the area is lit with a lamp, and the changed cells are destroyed.
why: For some precancerous skin changes, surface skin tumors, and sometimes acne - as decided by the doctor.
duration: the cream works for usually 1 to 3 hours, the lighting takes 10 to 20 minutes; healing takes 1 to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially ones that make you sensitive to the sun
If you have had sun reactions or cold sores (herpes) on your face

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: Do not sunbathe for a few days before the procedure. Do not use scrubs or irritating products.

prepare.title: Trip home
prepare.text: After the procedure your skin must be hidden from light - bring a hat, scarf and dark glasses.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: With the waiting, the procedure takes several hours - ask the clinic.

bring: A hat, scarf and dark glasses
Something to read while you wait
steps: Your skin is cleaned and sometimes crusts are lightly removed
You wait with a dressing on while the cream soaks in
The cream is washed off and your eyes are covered with protective goggles
The area is lit with a lamp for several minutes
The skin is cooled and a soothing product is applied
feel: During lighting - burning and tingling, which can be strong
The doctor can pause and cool your skin with air
after: For usually 1 to 2 days keep your skin protected from light, even from a bright lamp
Redness, swelling and crusts usually go away in 1 to 2 weeks
Do not pick off the crusts
After that use sunscreen every day
red_flags: Blisters, pus, severe pain or fever - see a doctor
Severe swelling around the eyes - see a doctor

faq.a: It burns during the lighting. Cooling and pauses usually help. Tell your doctor if it is hard to bear.

faq.q: How many sessions do I need?
faq.a: Often one or two. The doctor will tell you the exact number.

reminders.text: Photodynamic therapy tomorrow. Take a hat, scarf and dark glasses for the trip home.
